hook_en: Don't forget all His kind deeds. 🙏
reflect_en: David spoke to his own soul: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds. As this Thanksgiving weekend winds down, take a quiet moment to remember how He has forgiven you, carried you and crowned you with loving devotion and compassion this year.
q_en: What is one kind deed of God you never want to forget?
x_en: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds
tiktok: Remind your soul of this today 🙏 Psalm 103:1–5 — do not forget all His kind deeds
yt_title: Bless the LORD, O My Soul | Psalm 103:1–5 #Shorts
li_open: Busy seasons make it easy to forget what went right.
li_quote: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds
li_body: David had to remind his own soul to remember God's kindness: forgiveness, healing, redemption and compassion. Leaders who pause to recount answered prayers with their teams, and keep praying for the needs still in front of them, build a culture of gratitude instead of constant urgency.
hook_es: No olvides ninguno de Sus beneficios. 🙏
reflect_es: David le habló a su propia alma: Bendice, alma mía, a Jehová, y no olvides ninguno de sus beneficios. Este fin de semana, toma un momento para recordar cómo Dios te ha perdonado, te ha sostenido y te ha coronado de favores y misericordias este año.
q_es: ¿Qué beneficio de Dios nunca quieres olvidar?
x_es: Bendice, alma mía a Jehová, y no olvides ninguno de sus beneficios.
